technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (Hull, DC10, RSI-9) show bullish structure with three white soldiers pattern, but intermediate trend weakness (below 50-day MAs), negative CMF, and overbought StochRSI limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CMG shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated volatility risk with earnings in 7 days.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling pressure from junior members combined with market fear sentiment presents a mild contrarian buy setup, but lack of news data and absence of senior conviction limits conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (317.4) combined with critical earnings binary event in 7 days creates severe near-term risk for CMG despite normal yield curve.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip, DC10 new high, and three white soldiers pattern show short-term momentum structure with price near support (28.851), offering a defined risk entry for tactical swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary in 7 days combined with VIX crisis regime (317.4), overbought StochRSI, price below both 50-day MAs, negative CMF/AO, and zero fundamental/insider conviction make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Hull flip and DC10 new high provide short-term momentum structure at support, but critical earnings binary in 7 days combined with VIX crisis regime (317.4) creates unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 7 days will likely trigger violent price move regardless of technical setup; VIX crisis environment amplifies volatility beyond normal swing trade parameters.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical momentum insufficient to overcome fundamental/macro/risk headwinds
decision.portfolio_note: Already 5 positions in Consumer Discretionary sector; adding CMG increases concentration risk without conviction support.
